name: Time Technoplast Limited

timeline.x: [Scheme of Arrangement] Time Technoplast Limited has informed the Exchange about approval of the scheme of amalgamation (merger by absorption) of TPL Plastech Limited with Time Technoplast Limited and their respective shareholders and creditors.

[Commencement of commercial production/operations] Time Technoplast Limited has informed the Exchange about Completion of Greenfield Manufacturing Plant at Bhilad, Gujarat (India) and Commencement of Production

[Acquisition] The Board of Directors at its meeting held today, inter-alia, approved an investment of upto Rs. 50 Crores, in one or more tranches towards subscription to Equity Shares of Time Intercontinental Limited.
[General Updates] In-principle Approval for Merger of TPL Plastech Limited (Subsidiary Company) with Time Technoplast Limited (Holding Company), Subject to Further Approvals

[Outcome of Board Meeting] The Board of Directors of Time Technoplast Limited ( TTL ) at its meeting held today i.e. on August 26, 2026, inter-alia, transacted and approved the following businesses: 1. In-principle Approval for Merger of TPL Plastech Limited (Subsidiary Company) with Time Technoplast Limited (Holding Company), Subject to Further Approvals, 2. Board Decides Not to Proceed with Acquisition of Ebullient Packaging Private Limited ('EPPL'), 3. Approved Investment in Equity Shares of Time Intercontinental Limited (TICL)
[Acquisition] Time Technoplast Limited has informed the Exchange about Acquisition
